title: Sonic Trivia Pool
notes: Fact-checked starter pool gathered from the sources listed on each question. Questions are written for a general audience and can be expanded or rebalanced during the spec phase.

questions.question: What kind of animal is Sonic?
questions.explanation: Sonic is a blue hedgehog.

questions.question: What is Tails's real name?
questions.explanation: Tails's full name is Miles Prower, while Tails is his nickname.

questions.question: How many tails does Tails have?
questions.explanation: Tails is known for his two tails, which he can spin to fly.

questions.question: Which character protects the Master Emerald?
questions.explanation: Knuckles lives on Angel Island and guards the Master Emerald.

questions.question: What is Amy Rose's signature weapon?
questions.explanation: Amy is famous for her Piko Piko Hammer.

questions.question: What does Tails love working on?
questions.explanation: Tails loves tinkering with machines and supports Sonic with his engineering skills.

questions.question: Which ability is Knuckles especially known for?
questions.explanation: Knuckles is a powerful fighter who can glide and climb walls.

questions.question: What does Amy enjoy eating, according to her official profile?
questions.explanation: Amy's listed favorite food is soft-serve ice cream.

questions.question: What was the first main Sonic game released in 1991?
questions.explanation: The original Sonic the Hedgehog was released in 1991 for the Sega Genesis.

questions.question: What is the name of the first zone in the original Sonic game?
questions.explanation: Green Hill Zone is the first level of the original game.

questions.question: What do golden rings provide in the classic games?
questions.explanation: Having at least one ring lets Sonic survive one enemy or hazard hit, though the rings scatter.

questions.question: How many main zones does the original Sonic game have before the Final Zone?
questions.explanation: The original game has six principal zones, followed by a short Final Zone.

questions.question: What happens when 100 rings are collected in the original game?
options: The player earns an extra life
questions.answer: The player earns an extra life
questions.explanation: Collecting 100 rings grants an extra life in the original game.

questions.question: Which character was introduced as Sonic's sidekick in Sonic the Hedgehog 2?
questions.explanation: Sonic 2 introduced Miles Tails Prower as Sonic's sidekick.

questions.question: Which move debuted in Sonic the Hedgehog 2?
questions.explanation: Sonic 2 introduced the Spin Dash, letting Sonic charge speed while curled into a ball.

questions.question: What is the name of Dr. Robotnik's space station in Sonic 2?
questions.explanation: Robotnik seeks the Chaos Emeralds to power the Death Egg space station.

questions.question: What kind of course appears in Sonic 2's special stages?
questions.explanation: The special stages use a 3D-style half-pipe course where players collect rings and avoid bombs.

questions.question: How many Chaos Emeralds can be collected in Sonic 2?
questions.explanation: Sonic 2's special stages offer seven Chaos Emeralds.

questions.question: Who composed the soundtrack for the original Sonic game?
questions.explanation: Masato Nakamura of Dreams Come True composed the original soundtrack.

questions.question: Which company published the original Sonic the Hedgehog?
questions.explanation: Sega published the original Sonic the Hedgehog for the Sega Genesis.

questions.question: Which arcade game featured Sonic in a cameo before his first starring game?
questions.explanation: Sonic first appeared as a decorative rearview-mirror cameo in Rad Mobile in 1990.

questions.question: Who designed Sonic's original character?
questions.explanation: Naoto Ohshima designed the original Sonic character at Sega R&D9.

questions.question: What name was Sonic given during early development?
questions.explanation: Early concept sketches referred to Sonic as Mr. Hedgehog.

questions.question: Why was Sonic's color changed to dark blue during development?
options: To make him look like Shadow
questions.explanation: Sonic's dark blue color was chosen to match Sega's cobalt blue logo and improve contrast.
